{{Quote|We&hellip; appear to have suffered a brief technical fault. Um&hellip; Psst, Taro, switch the feed!|The Republic announcer|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Taro''' was an individual who worked on a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] news network during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. When the [[Chevin Conglomerate]]'s message interrupted the standard broadcasting, the announcer told Taro to switch the feeds.
